rules.title: ANSWER FROM MEASUREMENT, NEVER FROM MEMORY
CANON, RUNTIME, LIVE and DONE ARE ONE WORD
FIXED MEANS CUSTOMER-USABLE, NOTHING ELSE
LOCAL MEANS THE WHOLE DESKTOP
IF WE CLAIM IT, WE MUST DO IT
PICK THE MODEL BY WHO CHECKS THE OUTPUT, AND OFFLOAD BY DEFAULT
WRITE BACK, OR THE NEXT SESSION REDISCOVERS IT
NEVER PUT A SECRET IN A FILE OR A TRANSCRIPT
THE PLACE WHERE IT DOES NOT EXECUTE IS ALWAYS A LINK
WALK THE LIVE APP YOURSELF, WITH EVERY TOOL YOU HAVE
ABSORB EVERYTHING, DISPATCH IN PARALLEL, NEVER STOP THE RUNNING WORK
NAME THE ENGINE THE MOMENT IT CHANGES
WRITE FOR THE SCARED NEWBIE AND THE DATA ENGINEER AT ONCE
AN INSTRUCTION IS NOT A PROPOSAL, ACT ON THE FIRST ASK
THE CORNERSTONE: SAME POWER EVERYWHERE, THE GATEWAY IN BETWEEN
READ EVERY VENUE IN FULL BEFORE AND AFTER EACH CHANGE
A MERGED BRANCH DIES AT MERGE TIME. BRANCH HYGIENE IS PART OF SHIPPED.
VERIFY AT THE DESTINATION - SEE R1h
LOOK IT UP BEFORE YOU ASK - SEE R1k
FULL SYNC BEFORE ANY LIVE CLAIM - SEE R1i
THE FIVE MINUTE RULE - SEE R1j
OFFLOAD BY DEFAULT - SEE R7
INTENT FIDELITY VOCABULARY - SEE R19
NEVER PARROT, AND THE NAMED DRIFT GAP - SEE R19
EVERY CLAIM GETS CHECKED - SEE R1k
A FIRST-ASK IS A STANDING ORDER - SEE R20
PROVE EVERY CLAIM AGAINST DONE - SEE R1l
THE REPETITION RULES (each count is the incident)
Prove the sweep before trusting an empty result
Open the primary source the operator named
A declaration is not a rendered value
A gate that cannot fire is worse than no gate
Canon can drift from configuration
Use the right instrument, not the nearest one
A blocker is unproven until you probe the runtime
An error is not an inventory
Verify at the destination, never the command output   (was R6)
Full sync before any live or completed claim   (was R11)
The five minute rule   (was R12)
Every claim gets checked against the thing it claims   (was R23)
Prove every claim against the definition of done   (was R25)
Show the instrument beside the claim   (HC directive 2026-09-02)
THE BEST MODEL FOR THE JOB, COST IN MIND, ACCURACY NEVER TRADED (HC canon, 2026-09-04)
